title: the Indian mythos
audit_comment: THE INDIAN MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round twelve, print pp. 75-80. The headline adjudication: the PSIONIC THREE-PIPE CATCH - the Indra glyph group reads TI! at 47px word width and Kali prints III as I(9)I(10)I(10) in the chocr char geometry, exactly the Kali three-pipe class III and the Indra class III (the Termux voice read 11l and 1Nl, both three glyphs) - the chocr 600dpi calibration: single pipe w10, V w36, VI w49, III w47. The fraction fingerprint rides again: the Ushas (514) and Varuna (614) size cells are the half-foot clusters (small-1 w24 + low-4 w40), 5 1/2 and 6 1/2 foot, 66 and 78 inches. The Surya AC catch: the chocr reads the minus three the Termux dash dropped. The flagged odd prints pinned as printed: Indra AC the em-dash minus twelve, Kali move 27 without a slash, Kali wisdom 5 and MR 39 percent, the Marut move 9 apostrophe, the Buffalo 12 inch shoulders cell, Yama MR 25 with the 100 percent robes.

banner.title: the Indian mythos - the D&DG walk round twelve, print pp. 75-80: eighteen beings from Indra the first ruler of the gods and master of the atmosphere to Yama the judge of the dead and his water buffalo, the six greater gods (Indra, Agni, Rudra, Surya, Varuna, Vishnu), the three lesser gods (Kali, Lakshmi, Ushas), the four demigods (Karttikeya, Ratri, Tvashtri, Yama), and the five monsters across nine plane codes.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 076-081; the second printing) with the column-split tsv dumps; the collation voice: the archive.org 1st-print derivative (deities-demigods-1st-print) - the chocr char-level word geometry at 600dpi plus the djvu.xml word geometry. The adjudications: the psionic three-pipe catch (Indra TI! w47 and Kali III I(9)I(10)I(10), both class III; single pipe w10 Agni, Tvashtri, Vishnu; V w36 Ratri, Rudra, Yama; VI w49 Karttikeya, Lakshmi, Surya, Ushas, Varuna), the fraction fingerprint (Ushas 5 1/2 = 66, Varuna 6 1/2 = 78, the small-1 + low-4 clusters), the Surya AC -3 over the Termux bare dash, the MU/I See below 99/99 of Agni and Yama (the egp Isis precedent), the three paladin pairs (Surya 16, Varuna 14, Vishnu 17), the Kali in-each double pair (C/D 10 and MU/I 15), and the flagged odd prints pinned: Indra AC em-dash minus twelve, Kali move 27, Kali wisdom 5 and MR 39, the Marut move 9 apostrophe, the Buffalo 12 inch shoulders, Yama MR 25 robes 100.

tables.name: the combat grid
col_comments: The armor class cells (Vishnu -5 the best of the gods, Indra the flagged em-dash minus twelve odd print, Kali -9; the Buffalo 3 the worst)
The range ceiling cells (0 = a single printed armor class; all eighteen read single this round)
The hit point cells (Indra 400 the supreme, down to the four 100 hp monsters)
The primary move cells (Kali the flagged 27 odd print without a slash; Tvashtri and Yama 15; the Marut the flagged 9 apostrophe print)
The secondary move cells (Lakshmi the 75 lotus ceiling, Garuda the 48 flight, the Peacock 24/36; 0 = the single-printed moves)
The attack count cells (Karttikeya the ten swords, the Elephant 5, Kali 4; Lakshmi and Ushas the zero rows)
The attack alternative cells (Varuna the one 3/2 slash of the round)
The magic resistance cells (0 = the printed Standard of the Peacock and the Buffalo; Lakshmi the 100 ceiling, Vishnu 85, Indra 80; Yama the flagged 25 with the 100 percent robes note)
The size cells in inches (the two pixel-verified X 1/2 foot fractions - Ushas 66, Varuna 78; the Buffalo the one true-inch 12 inch shoulders cell; Garuda the 720 sixty-footer)
